caption:
A quiet hour, a cup of tea and one lily at a time. 🌸

My new Lily Flower book has 50 coloring pages of elegant blooms, botanical bouquets and detailed floral line art, one design per page. Many of the petals have fine stippling, so there's lots to fill with colored pencils, markers or gel pens. A tablet works too.

The pages are US Letter 8.5 x 11 in. You get a print-ready PDF plus 50 JPG images as an instant download, and you can print at home as many times as you like.
